# PageBlock Beta 0.2.0

The second public beta of **PageBlock** is here, bringing critical stability fixes, interface synchronization, and a brand-new feature!

## What's New in Beta 0.2.0

### Features & New Content
* **Implemented the Guide Book:** The new custom guidebook item is now fully implemented and active in the game to help you navigate the mod's features.

### Bug Fixes & Refinements
* **Fixed Interface Item Loss:** Resolved the container desynchronization bug. Leaving paper or components inside the Press interface will no longer cause them to disappear when you close the GUI; items are now safely returned to your inventory.
* **Visual & Rendering Tweaks:** Resolved minor graphical artifacts and rendering issues within the interfaces.

## Known Issues

* Some PDFs may render slower on their first load.
* Performance may vary depending on the size and complexity of the document.
* Additional improvements and optimizations are planned for future versions.

Thank you for testing PageBlock! Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are greatly appreciated.

# PageBlock Beta 0.1

The first public beta of **PageBlock** is here!

PageBlock is a Forge mod for **Minecraft 1.20.1** that allows players to read **PDF documents directly inside the game**, making it useful for guides, manuals, documentation, educational content, and custom books.

## Features

* Read PDF files without leaving Minecraft.
* Supports multi-page documents.
* PDF books can be placed on lecterns and read from them.

## Notes

This is the first beta release. Some features are still under development, and bugs or unexpected behavior may occur.

## Requirements

* Minecraft **1.20.1**
* Forge **47.x**

## Known Issues

* Some PDFs may render slower on their first load.
* Performance may vary depending on the size and complexity of the document.
* Additional improvements and optimizations are planned for future versions.
* The guidebook mod has not yet been implemented. 
* If you leave an item in the press interface, it will disappear when you exit it.

Thank you for testing PageBlock! Feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are greatly appreciated.
